summary: Rithm Capital Corp. filed an 8-K to announce the pricing of a $500 million private offering of 8.500% senior unsecured notes due 2031. The offering is expected to close on May 14, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including possible debt repayment. The notes are offered only to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S, with no registration rights. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
